subject.title: fix(gateway): bound BOOT.md file read size

question: Should a BOOT.md larger than 16 MiB be reported as a failed boot check or silently skipped as empty?
rationale: Both outcomes prevent unbounded allocation, but they differ materially in whether operators learn that shipped startup automation did not execute; repository history and current documentation do not define this new limit behavior.

options.title: Fail visibly
options.body: Return the existing failed result with the size-limit error so operators know their startup instructions were omitted.

options.title: Skip as empty
options.body: Continue startup and classify oversized BOOT.md content as empty without an operator-visible failure.

recommendation.title: Fail visibly
recommendation.body: Return the existing failed result with the size-limit error so operators know their startup instructions were omitted.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the original BOOT.md behavior and are the strongest feature-history owner for its operator-facing result contract.
